purpose: Complete production runtime contract for eight scene types. Builder assembles; runtime plays; planner/builder enforce bounded planned duration.

activation.rule: Only current scene is active. Runtime adds play on start. Remove both on exit. Scene7 remains active permanently.

builderRuntimeManifest.security: Serialize JSON and escape '<' as \u003c to prevent script-element termination. No executable planner/data code.

scene8.rule: All compact rows are present immediately; each result/comment resolves sequentially at the configured fast stagger. Effects overlap and never extend duration.

actionSemantics.genericReveal: For scene1/2, action name selects all [data-reveal='<name>'] and adds is-visible.
actionSemantics.scene2Fx: At fxStart execute each capability in root data-fx-package after verdict is visible.
actionSemantics.pnlNeedle: On P&L reveal, read data-pnl-to and set [data-role='pnl-needle'] left using clamp(50+(pnl/200)*48,2,98)%.
actionSemantics.scene4to8: Approved CSS choreography is driven by adding play; their CSS delays own individual reveals.
actionSemantics.scene8: Runtime adds is-resolved to each .s8-bet at resultRevealMs in order and updates global P&L from data-running-pnl/data-race-time at the same instant.

audio.autoplay: Attempt after first user interaction/play action; browser autoplay rejection is non-fatal and recap continues silently until user interaction permits audio.

pauseResume.rule: Pause freezes logical scene timer, CSS animations, soundtrack and active replay video. Resume continues from elapsed position without restarting scene or soundtrack.
pauseResume.css: Runtime applies animation-play-state:paused under body.runtime-paused for active scene descendants.

replay.start: After loadedmetadata, targetStart=max(0,duration-48). For normal long-form race replays this starts 48 seconds before the MP4 end.
replay.failure: Metadata timeout/error, play rejection/timeout or media error: restore music, show exit veil, wait 550ms then advance. Replay failure never stalls recap.
replay.end: Successful playback runs on the existing 17-second runtime timeline, then uses a 550ms exit veil before advancing; media ended/failure may finish earlier.
replay.outcomeFx: replayResult and replayBetType are required in the Scene 3 runtime payload. At 12400ms every winning wager shows the standard celebration package plus a mandatory 42-coin gold burst and one existing secondary celebration package. Payoff wording is wager-type aware: PLACE wins say PLACE BET WON!, WIN wagers may use the existing stronger win payoff pool, and other winning wager types use BET WON! so the UI never implies the replayed runner won the race when only the wager won. LOSS replays show a large frustrated payoff plus five sad/frustrated emoji pops, then a second distinct loss payoff at 13550ms. LOSS never triggers WINNER/BOOM/coins/confetti celebration. Outcome FX overlap the existing 17-second replay and add no duration.

sharing.shareTitle: Runtime derives '<user visible recap title>' as 'My TAB Racing Day Recap'.
sharing.shareUrl: Runtime uses location.href with fragment removed.
sharing.behavior: navigator.share({title,text,url}) when available; otherwise copy caption + URL to clipboard. Failure leaves Scene7 visible.

delivery.perBet: Scene2 root and Scene5 race nodes use data-fx-package.
delivery.lifecycle: Scene3 replay lifecycle capabilities implied by scene type; Scene7 finale capability derived from heroOutcomeClass.
delivery.fastResults: Scene8 uses template-local lightweight effects only; no heavy global per-bet FX package and no effect may extend scene duration.

formatting.currency: AUD $ prefix; no unnecessary .00; positive P&L +$; negative −$; zero $0
formatting.htmlSafety: Escape all factual/planner text; no text field contains presentation HTML; validate replay URLs as https URLs.

derivedHighlightAlgorithms.biggestWin: max positive profitLoss WIN; earliest tie
derivedHighlightAlgorithms.longestLosingStreak: longest consecutive LOSS run; earliest starting run tie
derivedHighlightAlgorithms.strongestFinish: suffix ending at final bet with greatest net gain; shortest suffix tie. If no positive suffix, final bet context is deterministic fallback.

productionTemplateExtraction.cssScopingRule: Selectors scoped to .scene-type-N except @keyframes. No html/body/:root/global shell selectors.
productionTemplateExtraction.visualIntegrityRule: Preserve approved scene-specific CSS, including scoped visual variables, effects, responsive rules and choreography.
productionTemplateExtraction.rule: Extract only explicit marked sections for all eight approved scene templates; heuristic stripping forbidden.

durationPolicy.definition: Planned recap duration is time from Scene1 start until Scene7 activation; Scene7 is permanent and excluded from timed duration.
durationPolicy.priority: Exact chronological coverage and factual correctness always outrank duration targets. Never drop, duplicate, reorder or pad bets merely to hit a target.
durationPolicy.hardMaxBasis: The 330-second hard maximum applies to the deterministic user-visible planned timeline: scene durations, scene transitions, and Scene3 plannedPlaybackMs + exitFadeMs. Scene3 metadata/play timeout allowances are runtime failure-safety behaviour and are tracked conservatively but do not consume editorial duration budget.
durationPolicy.feasibility: Before LLM copy generation the deterministic planner must produce a legal structural plan whose user-visible planned duration does not exceed hardMaxSeconds. Exact chronological coverage and factual correctness remain mandatory.

scene8.layout: Compact horizontal result strips with substantially less vertical weight than Scene5. Two to five rows must fit without scrolling or clipping, including mobile portrait. Runner name, result and per-bet P&L are critical and must not be ellipsized.
scene8.sequence: Rows remain in betSequences order. Results/comments resolve one at a time, never simultaneously.
scene8.effects: Lightweight flash, colour, emoji/pop and accelerated progress-dot treatment are allowed but add zero timeline delay.
scene8.pnl: At each result reveal the global running P&L bar moves to that bet runningPnl. Values come from bettings.json via builder data attributes.
scene8.responsiveAcceptance: 2/3/4/5 rows must fit mobile portrait and short landscape; critical horse/result/P&L information must remain readable.
